metadata.description: Plugins for AI agent collaboration via phone-a-friend

plugins.name: phone-a-friend
plugins.description: Get second opinions and code reviews from other coding backends in Claude Code. Requires the phone-a-friend CLI and separately configured backends.

plugins.name: paf-tasks
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod: every phone-a-friend review as a thread of rounds with its verdict and findings, live progress while a reviewer works. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287+ and the phone-a-friend CLI 4.5.0+ on PATH.
